settings.heading: Which side should I use?
settings.content: Side sleepers: higher contour. Back sleepers: lower contour. Not sure? Start with the lower side and switch if your head tilts down toward the mattress.

settings.heading: The 3–7 night adjustment period
settings.content: Ergonomic pillows hold your neck in a position it may not be used to. Mild awareness in the neck muscles for the first few nights is normal. Most people settle in within a week.

settings.heading: Delivery & Cash on Delivery
settings.content: Free delivery to all of Lebanon. Beirut & Mount Lebanon: usually 1–2 business days; other regions: 2–4. Pay cash or Whish Money on delivery. We confirm every order on WhatsApp before dispatch.

settings.heading: Care instructions
settings.content: Machine-wash the cover cold on a gentle cycle and air dry. Never wash the foam; spot clean only. Air the pillow for 24–48h after unboxing.

settings.question: Is it normal for Pilo to feel firm or strange at first?
settings.answer: Yes. Your neck has adapted to years of unsupported sleep. Most people need 3–7 nights to adjust to an ergonomic pillow, and you may notice your neck muscles as they adapt to a neutral position. Give it at least a week; that's why every Pilo comes with a 30-night trial.

settings.question: Which side of the pillow should I use?
settings.answer:
Side sleepers: use the higher side. It fills the gap between your shoulder and ear.
Back sleepers: use the lower side. Your chin shouldn't tilt toward your chest, and your head shouldn't tip back.

settings.question: Will Pilo fix my neck pain?
settings.answer: Pilo is designed to support healthy cervical alignment while you sleep, which many people find reduces morning stiffness. It is not a medical device or treatment. If you have persistent or severe pain, please consult a doctor or physiotherapist.

settings.question: Is there a smell when I open it?
settings.answer: New memory foam can have a light, harmless “new” scent for 24–48 hours. Remove the packaging and let it air in a ventilated room.

settings.question: Will it make me hot?
settings.answer: The cover uses a breathable cooling fabric, made with Lebanon's humid summers in mind.

settings.question: How do I wash it?
settings.answer: Unzip and machine-wash the cover only on a cold (30°C max), gentle cycle, then air dry. Do not wash or soak the foam. Spot-clean it with a damp cloth and keep it away from direct sun and heaters.

settings.question: Do you deliver everywhere in Lebanon?
settings.answer: Yes, we deliver to every governorate. Beirut and Mount Lebanon orders usually arrive in 1–2 business days, other regions in 2–4 business days.

settings.question: How does Cash on Delivery work?
settings.answer: Place your order online and pay the courier in cash when Pilo arrives. No card needed.

settings.question: Can I pay with Whish Money?

settings.question: Will you contact me before delivery?
settings.answer: Yes. We confirm every order on WhatsApp or by phone before dispatch, and the courier calls before arriving.

settings.question: What if Pilo isn't right for me?
settings.answer: Contact us within 30 nights of delivery and we'll arrange a pickup for a refund or exchange. See our refund policy for the full conditions.
